title: 第4章 万能小黄盆，这卫生吗？
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: 夕阳下，陆阳的影子被拉长，缩短，拉长，再缩短。堂哥和两个老战友靠在栏杆上，看着跑道上挥汗如雨，始终不肯停歇的陆阳，笑容里透着回忆。“刚入伍那会儿，全班就属我跑的最慢，班长拿着武装带，啪啪啪的往我屁股上抽。”“我比你好不到哪去，下连后从三公里改成五公里，差点儿没要了我半条命。”“那还是我们最舒服，我们单位是后勤，抓训练抓的不严，大差不差的就行了。”三个老战友笑哈哈的聊着，就像是看到曾经刚参军入伍时的自已。但陆阳的表现，又和当年的他们不太一样。明明基础比他们还差，但骨子里那股韧劲却要强得多。就连陆林都对自已这个堂弟有些刮目相看，记忆里他这个弟弟做事经常三分钟热度。却没想到，能在训练上报以极大的热情，并且从头到尾都没有偷过懒，没喊过一次累。但他却不知道，陆阳沉浸双倍提升的快乐之中，根本无法自拔！“行了，歇歇吧！”圆脸络腮胡冲着精疲力竭，步子都快迈不开的陆阳喊了一声。陆阳这才缓缓的，拖着沉重的身体朝着三人这边走来。“歇歇吧。”堂哥提醒：“平时不运动，一下子练得太狠，晚上睡觉会抽筋的。”陆阳张个大嘴，喘着粗气：“你，你不早说？”堂哥嘿嘿坏笑：“你也没问啊？”他递了瓶汽水过去：“补充补充水分。”陆阳也没客气，玻璃瓶的汽水，风味上要比易拉罐好喝很多。连吸管都不用，仰头吨吨吨喝了个干净，畅快的打了一个饱嗝，引得几人笑成一片。没有什么是比剧烈运动流汗以后，来一瓶冰镇汽水，更让人快活的事儿了。陆阳意念一动从系统里调出身体属性面板，发现速度，臂力，耐力等各项身体指标，后头都多了个“↑”的箭头。这意味着，他在学到新东西的同时，身体素质也在锻炼中成倍增长。只要保持这个势头下去，绝对能在部队里出人头地。趁着休息这会儿，陆阳让几个老兵讲讲部队里的一些新鲜事，尤其是那些个旁人不知道的门门道道。“在部队里，凡事都得抢着干，越脏越苦越累的活儿越是如此。”“只有积极表现，才能让班排长，甚至是连长注意到你，才能争取留队机会。”“妈的，当时我就是知道的太晚了，所以申请留队没能通过，指导员给我的评价是好吃懒做......”圆脸络腮胡满脸憋屈的拍着大腿，整个人都显得十分憋屈。看得出来，他是想留队，但是没能留下来的那种。听说部队里留队名额有限，只有表现好，能力突出的才有机会继续留下来。义务兵津贴，每个月一千二三的样子，但如果留队成功转为士官，津贴直接就是五六千，比在外头上班高多了。这也是为什么陆阳会更倾向于选择参军入伍，而不是去复读上学的其中原因之一。往后会有越来越多的大学生去参军，退伍军人的优厚待遇越来越好。如果能够干满十二年，还能直接包分配铁饭碗。这是唯一不需要去参加考试，就能成为公务人员一条路径，简直是赢麻了。另一个老兵则告诉陆阳，如果进部队后的第一顿饭，是用小黄盆装着面条切记一定要少吃。尤其是那种，盆边有毛刺，伤痕累累的那种，更得注意了。“为啥？”陆阳不理解。“你知道，部队里小黄盆是用来干啥的吗？”“洗衣服？”“洗衣，洗脚，和面，包饺，装土，掏粪.......”“等等，等等！”陆阳连忙叫停，不可置信的问：“掏粪是什么意思？那是盆啊，又不是粪勺？”那人嘿嘿一笑：“不然怎么叫万能的小黄盆？回头你上网搜搜图片就知道了，保准你当天吃不下饭。”陆阳满脸嫌弃，搞不懂为啥部队不能多发几个盆？这又是洗脚，又是和面的，不干净不卫生吧？要是把什么大肠杆菌，脚气，鸡眼，包到饺子里怎么办？这时，他扭头看向堂哥，好奇询问：“哥，你是因为啥退伍的，当时咋没留队？”堂哥从口袋里摸出一包烟，拍了拍点着一根，意味深长的说：“当初整个班，我问了一圈，个个都说退伍，结果就我一人交了申请。”“不过，我们那会儿赶上军改，好些人不想走的也得走。”“我们连有个标兵，各项优秀，拿过许多奖，就是文化成绩低了点.........”陆阳问：“因为文化成绩太低，所以被部队给淘汰了？”堂哥摇摇头：“那倒不是，他是战备执勤的时候打瞌睡，醒来以后发现身上多了一件麦穗将星的军装。”“然后我们连被全军通报批评，营长，连长，指导员从上到下挨了一遍处分。”陆阳哭笑不得：“那他是得走，不走得被打死的.......”几人正有说有笑的聊着，忽然瞧见远处操场似乎有两群年轻人正在聚集。瞧这阵仗，像极了社会青年约架，当地俗称“摆台子”。而对于操场上铺开的阵仗，三个退伍老兵只是轻蔑笑笑，给出相对中肯的评价。“一帮傻叉.......”“这帮小子，但凡进了部队，一天得被收拾八百回。”“陆阳记住了，在部队里当什么都不要当刺头。因为老兵班长，最喜欢做的，就是拔刺！”陆阳看了那边一眼，以他现在过来人的心态，再看这种所谓的高中时代约架，简直无聊透顶浪费时间。但凡有这闲工夫，去偷俩电瓶，都算是搞事业谋发展了。这时，口袋里电话忽然响起，那头的父亲语气十分激动。“儿子，赶紧回来，人武部的同志来了，你的入伍通知书下来了！”
content_en: Under the setting sun, Lu Yang's shadow was lengthened, shortened, lengthened, and then shortened again.The cousin and two old comrades leaned on the railing, looking at Lu Yang who was sweating profusely on the track and never stopped, with memories in his smile."When I first joined the army, I was the slowest runner in the class. The squad leader took the armed belt and slapped my butt." "I'm not much better than you. After I joined the company, I changed it from three kilometers to five kilometers, which almost killed me.""That's the most comfortable thing for us. Our unit is a logistics unit, and the training is not strict. It's just about right."The three old comrades laughed and chatted, as if they saw themselves when they had just joined the army.But Lu Yang's performance was different from what they had done back then.Obviously the foundation is worse than them, but the tenacity in the bones is much stronger.Even Lu Lin looked at his cousin with admiration. In his memory, his younger brother often did things with enthusiasm within three minutes.But I didn't expect that I would respond with great enthusiasm to the training, and I would never be lazy or cry out that I was tired from the beginning to the end.But he didn't know that Lu Yang was immersed in the happiness of double improvement and couldn't extricate himself!"Okay, let's take a rest!" The round-faced and bearded Lu Yang shouted to Lu Yang, who was exhausted and could hardly walk.Lu Yang then slowly walked towards the three of them, dragging his heavy body."Have a rest." The cousin reminded: "If you don't exercise normally, if you train too hard all of a sudden, you will get cramps when you sleep at night." Lu Yang opened his mouth wide and gasped: "You, didn't you tell me earlier?" The cousin chuckled mischievously: "You didn't even ask?" He handed over a bottle of soda: "Replenish water." Lu Yang was not polite. Soda in glass bottles has a much better flavor than cans.He didn't even use a straw, he raised his head and drank it all, and burped happily, which made several people laugh.There is nothing more pleasurable than having a bottle of ice-cold soda after sweating through strenuous exercise.With a thought, Lu Yang called up the physical attribute panel from the system and found that speed, arm strength, endurance and other physical indicators had an "↑" arrow at the back.This means that while he is learning new things, his physical fitness is also growing exponentially through exercise.As long as you keep this momentum going, you will definitely be able to get ahead in the army.Taking advantage of the break, Lu Yang asked a few veterans to talk about some new things in the army, especially those things that others didn't know."In the army, everything has to be done in a hurry, and the dirtier, harder and more tiring the job is, the more so." "Only by showing positive performance can the platoon leader and even the company commander notice you, and you can win the opportunity to stay in the team." "Damn it, I knew it too late at the time, so my application to stay in the team was not approved. The instructor gave me the evaluation that I was lazy and lazy..." He patted his thigh with an aggrieved face with a round face and a beard, and he looked very aggrieved.It was obvious that he wanted to stay on the team, but couldn't.I heard that the number of places to stay in the army is limited, and only those with good performance and outstanding abilities will have the opportunity to stay.The compulsory soldier's allowance is 1,230 yuan per month, but if he stays in the army and successfully becomes a non-commissioned officer, the allowance is 5,000 to 6,000 yuan, which is much higher than working outside.This is one of the reasons why Lu Yang is more inclined to join the army instead of repeating his studies in school.In the future, more and more college students will join the military, and the preferential treatment for veterans will become better and better.If you can work for twelve years, you can be directly assigned an iron rice bowl.This is the only way to become a civil servant without taking an exam, which is a real win.Another veteran told Lu Yang that if his first meal after joining the army was noodles in a small yellow basin, he must eat less.Especially the kind with burrs and scars on the edge of the basin, you need to pay more attention to it."Why?" Lu Yang didn't understand."Do you know what the little yellow basin is used for in the army?" "Washing clothes?" "Laundry, washing feet, kneading dough, making dumplings, filling soil, digging out excrement..." "Wait, wait!" Lu Yang stopped quickly and asked in disbelief: "What does excrement mean?""Think? That's a basin, not a dung spoon?"The man chuckled and said, "Otherwise, you can search for pictures on the Internet and find out."Lu Yang looked disgusted and didn't understand why the army couldn't send out more basins.This is foot washing and dough kneading. It’s not clean and hygienic, right?What if we put E. coli, athlete's foot, and corns into dumplings?At this time, he turned to look at his cousin and asked curiously: "Brother, why did you retire from the army? Why didn't you stay in the team?" The cousin took out a pack of cigarettes from his pocket, patted one and lit one, and said meaningfully: "I asked around the whole class, and everyone said they quit.Wu, I was the only one who submitted the application.""However, we were undergoing military reform at that time, and many people had to leave even if they didn't want to." "We have a pacesetter in our company, who is excellent in all aspects and has won many awards, but his cultural scores are a bit low..." Lu Yang asked.: "Because his cultural performance was too low, he was eliminated from the army?" The cousin shook his head: "That's not true. He fell asleep when he was preparing for combat duty. When he woke up, he found that he had an extra military uniform of General Maosui." "Then our company was criticized by the whole army.The battalion commander, company commander, and instructor were punished from top to bottom." Lu Yang couldn't laugh or cry: "Then he has to leave, otherwise he will be beaten to death..." Several people were chatting and laughing when they suddenly saw two groups of young people gathering in the playground in the distance.Look at this battle, it looks like a fight between young people in society, which is commonly known as "setting up a stage" in the local area.As for the battle unfolding on the playground, the three veterans just smiled contemptuously and gave a relatively fair evaluation."A bunch of idiots..." "These guys, if they join the army, they will be punished eight hundred times a day." "Lu Yang, remember, don't be a thorn in anything in the army. Because what the veteran squad leader likes to do most is to pull out thorns!" Lu Yang glanced over there. With the mentality of someone who has experienced it now, looking at this so-called high school date is simply a boring waste of time.Anyone who has the spare time to steal a couple of batteries can be regarded as pursuing a career and seeking development.At this time, the phone in his pocket suddenly rang, and the father on the other end sounded very excited."Son, come back quickly. Comrades from the People's Armed Forces Department are here. Your enlistment notice is here!"
